=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Phase 3c/4b | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The bait-commit editor exercise can be skipped by the default self-triggered autofix filter, so the expected editor run never happens.
  WHY: The workflow itself pushes the bait commit, and if it matches the `[ai-autofix]`/bot-identity heuristic the subsequent synchronize event can be classified as self-triggered and skipped.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:orphan-workflows-test job | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The orphan-workflows-test job waits for dispatched workflows without explicit timeout handling, so a stalled workflow can block the release gate indefinitely.
  WHY: The job dispatches multiple workflows and then waits for completion, but no timeout guard or bounded wait logic is described.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Phase 7 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The cancel-on-PR-close test is timing-sensitive and can race GitHub event delivery.
  WHY: The smoke PR is closed and the workflow is checked to completion, but the `pull_request.closed` event may not have propagated yet when the assertion runs.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Smoke-test branch | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The smoke test runs at low reasoning effort and may miss failures that only appear at higher production reasoning levels.
  WHY: The smoke path uses lower effort than the production pipeline, so bugs dependent on deeper cross-file or control-flow reasoning may not be exercised.
- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py:Phase 8 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The soft-error analyser is non-blocking, so recurring soft failures do not stop a release.
  WHY: The analyser only reports issues and does not fail the release even when it finds repeated rate-limit recoveries, codex fallbacks, or summarizer/editor failures.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:e2e-alt-model-test job | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The alt-model e2e test can block the release gate on an external model availability or access problem.
  WHY: The job depends on `ALT_EDITOR_MODEL`, so if that model or its API access is unavailable, the release gate fails even though the primary path is unaffected.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Phase 3c/4b | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The bait-commit editor exercise can be skipped by the default `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED=true` setting.
  WHY: The workflow’s own bait commit can be classified as self-triggered, which prevents the reviewer/editor cycle from running and makes Phase 4b fail.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:orphan-workflows-test job | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The orphan-workflows-test job does not specify explicit timeout handling for dispatched workflow waits.
  WHY: If one of the dispatched workflows hangs or runs extremely long, the release gate can block indefinitely.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Phase 7 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cancel-on-PR-close test may race GitHub event delivery latency.
  WHY: The workflow could check for cancellation before the PR-close event has propagated and triggered `internal-cancel-on-pr-close.yml`.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Smoke-test branch | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The smoke test uses low reasoning effort and may miss bugs that only appear at higher effort.
  WHY: The production pipeline runs with higher reasoning, so deeper-analysis failures may pass smoke tests but fail in production.
- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py:Phase 8 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The soft-error analyser is non-blocking by design.
  WHY: It can surface serious recurring issues but still allow the release to be tagged.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:e2e-alt-model-test job | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The alt-model e2e test introduces external dependency risk.
  WHY: If `ALT_EDITOR_MODEL` becomes unavailable or inaccessible, the release gate fails even though the primary production models are unaffected.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Phase 3c/4b | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The bait-commit editor exercise will be skipped by the default self-triggered autofix behavior.
  WHY: The bait commit is pushed by the gate itself, so a `[ai-autofix]` commit from the bot can be classified as self-triggered and skipped before the editor runs.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:orphan-workflows-test job | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The job waits for several dispatched workflows without explicit timeout enforcement.
  WHY: A stalled or infinite workflow run could keep the release gate waiting indefinitely.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:e2e-alt-model-test job | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The alt-model e2e test depends on an external model that may be unavailable or inaccessible.
  WHY: If `ALT_EDITOR_MODEL` cannot be used on OpenRouter or the API key lacks access, the release gate fails even though this test is orthogonal to the production path.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Phase 3c/4b | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The bait-commit editor exercise may be skipped by the self-triggered autofix filter.
  WHY: If the bait commit is authored by the bot and uses the `[ai-autofix]` prefix, the synchronize event can be skipped and the editor will never run.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:orphan-workflows-test job | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The orphan-workflows-test job may lack timeout handling.
  WHY: Without a timeout, a long-running dispatched workflow can stall the release gate.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Phase 7 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cancel-on-PR-close test is sensitive to GitHub event latency.
  WHY: The workflow may assert cancellation before the close event has had time to trigger the downstream cancel workflow.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
